name: dashboard-shell
description: One responsive dashboard chrome: React/Next remains the default shadcn rail/topbar/dock/tile-drawer distribution; explicit SvelteKit gets native Svelte 5 surfaces over the same portable nav core.
notes: React default needs shadcn sidebar + drawer. Explicit SvelteKit uses native CSS/runes/$app/state and shares only config + nav/core types; no shadcn, Lucide, Vaul, Convex, env, or localStorage.
